headline: 305 of 406 materials carry userData.surfaceUniforms whose onBeforeCompile no longer installs them, including the player's body. Establishing the population, fixing structurally at the copy seam, proving with a CONSUMPTION perturbation and hardware before/after frames.
mechanism_as_understood: visual-foundation.js#installSurfaceShader writes BOTH mat.userData.surfaceUniforms (bookkeeping) and mat.onBeforeCompile (the shader).
three r180 Material.copy() copies userData by JSON deep-copy and does NOT copy onBeforeCompile. So every .clone() keeps the bookkeeping and loses the shader.
SECOND, INDEPENDENT LOSS at the same seam: installSurfaceShader also does shadedMaterials.add(mat). A clone is not in that Set, so setWorldWetness() never reaches it even if its hook were intact.
THIRD, INDEPENDENT LOSS at the same seam: registerFamilyMaterial(family, mat) is not re-run for a clone, so the loud magenta ASSET-LOAD-FAILED fallback cannot stain a cloned material.
FOURTH: actor.js#installWaterline ASSIGNS mat.onBeforeCompile rather than chaining prior, so on the player's body it would destroy a restored surface pass anyway. Ordering saves nothing here.
